papers.title: MRgFUS for drug-resistant epilepsy: Preliminary report for prospective clinical trial.
papers.reason: This is a clinical feasibility study of focused ultrasound lesioning for epilepsy with EEG seizure outcomes, not a study of executive function, cognitive modelling, or cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Regulatory role of TIPE2 by inhibiting microglial pyroptosis and glycolysis in the treatment of sepsis‐associated encephalopathy
papers.reason: This animal study concerns molecular mechanisms of sepsis-associated cognitive dysfunction and EEG changes, but it does not address planning, working memory, attention, cognitive control, or computational assessment.
